title: Grimm Fairy Tales Annual #1
desc: After an arduous battle with Father Time and his minions that nearly takes her life, Sela Mathers awakens among the ruins of Myst—one of several realms destroyed during the villain’s very costly war. Now, lost and alone, she hopes to find her way home, but she must battle monstrous reflections of her former Fairy Tale allies now changed to Hollowborn—broken remnants of powerful souls lost during the temporal war. As she struggles to survive, she uncovers the horrifying truth behind the Hollowborn and the shocking malevolent force directing their actions from the shadows--Belle?!?
